in_marathi.name: Gati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Movement, progress, journey
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gati is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Gam' which means 'to go'. The name signifies movement, progress, and journey. In Hindu mythology, Gati is also considered the goddess of progress and advancement.
